item.title: Ladies: O'Sullivan goal steers Cork to victory over Galway
item.description: A goal from Aine O'Sullivan was the critical score for Cork as they got the better of Galway in their Lidl Ladies National Football League Division One clash at Páirc Ui Rinn.

item.title: Lidl National Football League round-up: Wins for Cork, Armagh, Mayo and Donegal
item.description: Cork gained a measure of revenge for last year's Lidl National League Division 2 final loss to Galway when they scored a 1-10 to 2-5 win when the sides clashed in the top flight on Sunday at Páirc Uí Rinn.

item.title: Westmeath maintain 100% league start while London produce upset against Longford
item.description: Westmeath made it maximum points from their first two outings in Division 3 of the Allianz Football League after seeing off Clare by 2-19 to 1-17 in Ennis this afternoon.

item.title: Clare cruise past Antrim to second win Division 1B as Wexford survive Down scare
item.description: Clare picked up their second win in Division 1B of the Allianz Hurling League by dishing out a 2-30 to 1-19 defeat to Davy Fitzgerald's Antrim side in Cushendall.

item.title: Royals and Rebels secure second victories in Division 2
item.description: Meath edged Cavan by 2-17 to 1-18 at Kingspan Breffni this afternoon to make it two wins from two in their Allianz Football League campaign.

item.title: Goals key as Rossies get up and running with victory over Monaghan
item.description: Three well-time goals helped Roscommon to get off the mark in their Allianz Football League Division 1 campaign at Monaghan's expense.

item.title: Five-star Tipp thump Offaly as Waterford inflict early loss on Limerick
item.description: Jason Forde netted a hat-trick as Tipperary scored an emphatic 5-24 to 1-18 win over Offaly in the sides' Allianz Hurling League Division 1A second round meeting in Tullamore this afternoon.

item.title: Ó Baoill goal helps Donegal inflict first league defeat on Kingdom
item.description: Donegal maintained their 100% start in the Allianz Football League by defeating holders Kerry on a 1-22 to 1-18 scoreline in Ballyshannon this afternoon.

item.title: Mayo impress in second-half to deal 14-man Dubs second league loss
item.description: Mayo recorded their second consecutive win Division 1 of the Allianz Football League after seeing off 14-man Dublin by 1-18 to 2-9 in Castlebar this afternoon.
